acceptance_profile.component_contracts: Bind ritual component requirements to Item/Asset references, qualities/tags, consumption/disposition and substitution policy without creating an inventory ledger or universal prices/rarities.
acceptance_profile.cooperative_casting: Define participant roles, contribution windows, coordination policy and aggregate proposal metadata while all authoritative supernatural execution remains MSS-03 Action/Event resolution and MSS-02 resource contracts.

acceptance_profile.validation: Focused MSS-07 tests plus exact-head repository health and governed self-hosted Windows/Linux deterministic comparison are required before merge.
